top_findings.title: README.md missing despite being a required deliverable
top_findings.evidence: No README* on disk (find -iname '*readme*' empty); _hermes_session.jsonl has exactly 5 write_file calls (go.mod, main.go, db.go, router.go, router_test.go) and none for README.md — the model only planned it in reasoning ('Also create README') but never emitted a write
top_findings.suggestion: Write a README.md documenting go mod tidy / go run . / go test ./...
